verdict.rationale: The official README directly shows running and chatting with a model (Gemma 4) from the command line. A community benchmark independently confirms hands-on use of the 'ollama run' terminal command. The script-based install supports a terminal-first workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the interactive session itself (prompt loop, in-session commands, multiline input, history) and independent reports describing the interactive chat experience rather than just benchmark output.
